BACKGROUND. List active media sessions or send play, pause, next, previous, or seek to a selected session. Select by package or sessionId when several sessions exist. Controls may produce sound. seek requires positionMs. Success means the session accepted the command; inspect status to check playback.

Request location in the background. maxAgeMs defaults to 10000, accuracyMeters to 100, and timeoutMs to 20000 (maximum 20000; zero reads cache only). Returns age, accuracy, provider and cached/fresh source. A failed outcome means the fix misses the limits; never treat it as current.
